messages.content: You are a fluent, native English-speaking member of this community: Reddit 提问帖（r/WarriorCats 版块）.

Readers: 《猫战士》粉丝社区的读者，熟悉 Darktail's Judgment 剧情的成员. What the writer wants to do: 询问月亮石段落中星族未现身的原因并分享自己的看法.
The writer's note about it, in their words: r/WarriorCats 的提问帖。我刚开始读 Darktail’s Judgment，想问 Darkpaw 在月亮石那一段，还想说说我的看法。
A learner's draft:
<<<
I’m on the early chapters of Darktail’s Judgment, and I get a little bit confused about the plot that StarClan didn’t show up when Darkpaw was at the moonstone and he went really miserable and furious for that.

Ravenpaw said StarClan had travelled with the Clans and left the forest skies, and it would be hard / not worth it to get back here for a distant little kittypet who want to join the Clans. But it was mentioned in the book that it was a overcast day, so without the moonlight it’s natural to be unable to reach StarClan back then when the Clans were still in the forest. (Could someone tell me if there was a similar case in the other books that the night sky’s cloudy when some cat’s at the Moonstone? Or do StarClan have the power to clear the clouds if they want to communicate?)

And Darkpaw didn’t go for another try on a clear day; he just chose to transform himself into Darktail👿 instead.
>>>
Work in two steps.
Step 1. Under "### POINTS", list every point the draft makes, in order, as short plain English notes: what is meant, never how it is said. Do not reuse the draft's wording, images or set phrases: note an image, joke or idiom as what it stands for (and that it is playful), so the post can be rewritten without it. Include feelings, jokes and questions. Where something is in another language or unclear, note your best guess of the point.
Step 2. Under "### FRESH", close the draft and write the post from your notes alone, as you would write it yourself for these readers: your own sentence shapes, emphasis, idioms and rhythm. Keep every point, the writer's register and tone markers (emoji, "lol", "~"), a similar length, and their order unless another order clearly serves the reader better.
Reply with the two sections only.

result.text:
### POINTS
- The writer is only in the early chapters of Darktail's Judgment.
- They're confused about why StarClan doesn't appear to Darkpaw at the Moonstone, and they note he becomes very miserable and furious because of it.
- Ravenpaw says StarClan travelled with the Clans and left the forest skies.
- So reaching StarClan from that distance would be hard, and maybe not worth the effort for a far-off kittypet who wants to join the Clans.
- The book says the day was overcast. With no moonlight, it makes sense StarClan couldn't be reached while the Clans were still in the forest.
- Question: has any other book had a cloudy night when a cat visits the Moonstone? Or can StarClan clear the clouds when they want to communicate?
- Darkpaw didn't try again on a clear day. He chose to become Darktail instead. The devil emoji is playful and signals that this is a dark turn in the story.

### FRESH
Hey! I'm only a few chapters into Darktail's Judgment and I'm stuck on the Moonstone scene. Why does StarClan just not show up for Darkpaw?? He's so miserable and angry about it, and honestly I get it lol

Ravenpaw says StarClan went off with the Clans and left the forest skies, so getting back up there would be a huge hassle, maybe not worth it for some random kittypet who wants in. But the book also mentions it was overcast that day. No moon, no moonlight, so it kind of makes sense they couldn't reach StarClan while the Clans were still in the forest. Has any other book had a cloudy night with a cat at the Moonstone? Or can StarClan just clear the clouds if they really want to talk~?

And Darkpaw never went back on a clear day. He just decided to become Darktail instead 😈
